QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Ship of Blood
QuestInfo.0: Captain Blood was shocked to see you bring down his men. But right when you thought you had him cornered, he escaped to his ship! Guess that's why he's the Pirate King.
QuestInfo.1: Captain Blood was shocked to see you bring down his men. But right when you thought you had him cornered, he escaped to his ship! Guess that's why he's the Pirate King. Leon didn't think you'd have another chance like this, so he proposed chasing Captain Blood onto his ship.
QuestInfo.2: You knew better than to send your own captain, Leon, so you boarded Captain Blood's ship alone. Of course, It was a trap.
